_help: KOL Vetting Scorecard. Each check has bands: the first band whose max is at or above the value gives its points and reason; flag: true also lists it as a red flag. Points across checks add up to 100. These bands are rules of thumb, not industry standards: review and tune them. The ROI defaults are guesses the visitor should replace with their own numbers.

checks.label: Engagement rate
checks.line: Average likes plus replies per post, as a share of followers.

bands.reason: Very few likes and replies for the follower count. A common sign of bought or inactive followers.
Low engagement for the follower count.
Healthy engagement: people really read and react.
Unusually high engagement. Check the replies are real people, not bots or engagement groups.

checks.label: Replies per 100 likes
checks.line: Real audiences talk back. Bought likes rarely come with replies.

bands.reason: Almost no replies compared with likes. Can mean bought likes.
A normal amount of replies for the likes.

checks.label: Follower growth per month
checks.line: Sudden jumps without a viral post are a warning sign.

bands.reason: Fast growth. Check it matches a real viral moment.
Very fast growth. A common sign of bought followers.

checks.label: Posts that are paid promos
checks.line: An account that is mostly ads has less trust with its audience.

bands.reason: Few paid posts, so the audience still trusts the feed.
A fair number of paid posts.
Many paid posts. The audience may ignore promotions.
Mostly paid posts. Reach and trust are likely low.

checks.label: Discloses paid posts
checks.line: Paid posts should clearly say they are paid. Hidden ads can break advertising rules and hurt your project too.

options.label: Sometimes
options.reason: Only sometimes marks paid posts. Make clear disclosure part of your deal.

options.label: Never
options.reason: Does not disclose paid posts. Undisclosed promotion can break advertising rules in many countries.

checks.label: Past promoted tokens that died
checks.line: What happened to the tokens they promoted before.

noData.reason: No track record of promoted tokens to check.

bands.reason: Most tokens they promoted are still alive.
Many tokens they promoted have died.
Most tokens they promoted have died. Their audience may have been burned before.

grades.label: Looks solid
grades.line: Good signs. Still ask for recent post stats and a clear disclosure clause.

grades.label: Okay, check more
grades.line: Mixed signs. Ask for screenshots of real post stats before you pay.

grades.label: Risky
grades.line: Several warning signs. Start with one small paid post, or skip.

grades.label: Walk away
grades.line: Too many warning signs for your money.

roiLine: Views and clicks are your own guesses. Ask the KOL for real views on recent posts, and track clicks with your own link.
